name: masked-value
title: Masked value
description: A sensitive value hidden until asked, such as •••• 4242 or j•••@example.com, with a reveal button that says what it does and a timer that hides it again.
docs: While hidden the markup holds only the masked text. The value is still a prop, so from a Server Component it is in the page payload: fetch it in onReveal if that matters. mask is card, email, phone, iban, full or your own function (from a client component); autoHideAfter hides it again and a polite status says so. Control it with revealed and onRevealedChange.
